headline: Drax's £20bn deal would turn polluting UK power plant into AI datacentre
summary: The owner of Britain's Drax power plant, the country's most polluting, has struck a £20 billion deal to build AI datacentre infrastructure on the site in North Yorkshire, potentially creating the UK's largest datacentre. The project still needs planning permission, government approval, and a customer before it can move forward.
